item.title: Understanding Proximity Controllers and RFID Door Access Solutions
item.description:
Proximity Controllers and RFID Door Access: Technology and Solutions
#

A proximity controller is a universal touchless technology designed to detect nearby objects using electromagnetic fields or beams of electromagnetic radiation, all without physical contact. This technology is widely implemented in RFID door entry systems, which have become an integral part of modern security and access control solutions.
